name: SiteZip – Backup & Restore
author: mdfirdousahmed

sections.description:
SiteZip saves your database and wp-content folder into a single .zip file. You can download it, import it on another site, and restore it with one click.

Why SiteZip?

Most backup plugins are built around accounts, license keys and long settings pages. SiteZip does one job: a complete copy of your site in one zip, on your own server, that restores fast.

  • Restores in seconds, not minutes. When you restore on the same site, files that have not changed are skipped. In testing, a 21 GB site restored in about 15 seconds.
  • No size limits. No cap on backup size and no cap on imports, even on hosts with small upload and time limits. A 21 GB site backed up in under two minutes in testing.
  • Your backups stay on your server. No sign-up, no license key, no tracking.
  • Repairs itself after a migration. After a restore, SiteZip loads the site to check it works. If a caching file copied from the old host breaks it, that file is turned off automatically.
  • One standard zip. Open it with any zip tool. Nothing is locked into a custom format.

Features

  • Full backups of any size. Work is split into short steps that run in the background, so large sites do not hit PHP time limits.
  • Fast restores. Files that have not changed are skipped, so restoring on the same site takes seconds instead of minutes.
  • Move sites. Restoring on a different address updates every URL in the database, including serialized data.
  • Import any way you like. Upload a .zip in the browser, or copy it into the backups folder by FTP and it shows up in the list.
  • Choose what goes in. Switch the media library, themes, plugins or other files on or off, and see the backup size before you start.
  • Private by default. Backups are stored in a folder with a random name, and downloads use one-time links that expire after two minutes.
  • Safe after a restore. SiteZip checks that the site still loads. If a caching drop-in copied from another host breaks it, that drop-in is turned off for you.
  • No accounts, no tracking. The plugin never contacts any outside service.

Credits

The completion sound (admin/sounds/complete.mp3) was made by the plugin author and is released under CC0.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open SiteZip in the admin menu.
  3. Click Back up now.
sections.faq:
Where are backups stored?

In wp-content/sitezip-backups- followed by a random code. They are kept outside the plugin folder, so updating the plugin does not delete them.

What happens to my backups if I delete the plugin?

They are kept. To remove them, choose “Deactivate and delete all data” when deactivating the plugin.

Does it work on multisite?

You can make backups on multisite, but restoring is turned off for multisite networks.

Where can I get help or suggest a feature?

Post in the SiteZip support forum. Questions, bug reports and feature ideas are all welcome there, and answers help other users too.

Does it send my data anywhere?

No. Backups never leave your server unless you download them. The only web requests the plugin makes go to your own site, to run background steps and to check the site after a restore.
